Anant Singh News: anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ka bhavy aayojan kaee vajhon se surkhiyon men raha.ghurdaur, shahi sajavat, mehmanon ka jamavra aur shandar intjam ne is shadi ko khas bana diya... dekhie anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ke aayojan ki puri jhalkiyan sirph Bihar Tak par...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
